title: TOPol: Reconstructing and Interpreting Multidimensional Semantic Polarity Fields
abstract: arXiv:2510.25069v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Polarity in natural language processing has long been operationalized as a single axis: the sentiment construct. We challenge this one-dimensional view by asking what a topic's documents are bipolar about, without specifying an answer in advance. TOPol inverts the usual concept-direction paradigm: rather than mapping a named construct to one direction, it maps a topic to the full set of statistically reproducible bipolar semantic axes its documents support in a transformer's residual stream, and asks only afterwards which of them correspond to a known construct. These axes need not be evaluative. The method is a recursive, orthogonal-by-construction bipartition of each topic's document cloud, with a candidate axis promoted to a finding only if it survives one pre-specified split-half stability gate. translated_title: TOPol：重构与解释多维语义极性场
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理中的极性长期以来一直被操作化为单一轴：即情感构念。我们通过追问一个主题下的文档究竟在哪些方面呈现两极对立，来挑战这种一维观点，而无需预先指定答案。TOPol 颠倒了通常的概念-方向范式：它不是将一个命名的构念映射到某一个方向上，而是将一个主题映射到其文档在Transformer残差流中所支持的全部统计上可复现的双极语义轴集合，之后再追问其中哪些轴对应于已知构念。这些语义轴不一定是评价性的。该方法对每个主题的文档云进行递归式、构造上天然正交的二分划分，且仅当候选轴通过预先设定的对半分割稳定性检验门槛时，才会被确认为一项研究发现。我们首先针对已知答案进行校准：在 Gemma 3 4B 模型上的 9,986 条亚马逊评论（发现 14 个主题）中，星级评分的差异…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TOPol 颠覆了传统单维情感分析范式，通过递归二分法将主题映射到Transformer残差流中所有统计可复现的双极语义轴集合，从而多维地重构和解释语义极性场。
en_tdlr: TOPol inverts the single-axis sentiment paradigm by mapping each topic to the full set of statistically reproducible bipolar semantic axes in a transformer's residual stream, thereby reconstructing and interpreting multidimensional semantic polarity fields.
